For a list values of n nonnegative integers, what is the tight worst-case running time of this Python 3.11 function? Each index moves only forward; arithmetic and comparisons are O(1).

def windows(values, limit):
    left = 0
    total = 0
    count = 0
    for right, value in enumerate(values):
        total += value
        while total > limit and left <= right:
            total -= values[left]
            left += 1
        count += right - left + 1
    return count

A) O(log n)
B) O(n log n)
C) O(n)
D) O(n²)
